name: Invocation Binding (weapon)
body:
Price: +2 bonus; Aura strong evocation and varies; CL 12th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

An invocation binding weapon allows an invoker to store a single targeted invocation of up to 2nd level in the weapon (The invocation must have a casting time of 1 standard action). Once per round if the weapon strikes a creature and the creature takes damage from it, the weapon can immediately cast the invocation on that creature as a free action if the wielder desires. This special ability can only be placed on melee weapons. While an invocation is stored in a weapon the invoker loses access to that invocation. An invoker may remove an invocation from an invocation binding weapon as a standard action. A invocation binding weapon emits a strong aura of the evocation school, plus the aura of the invocation currently stored.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Special creator have the invoker’s pact class feature; Cost +2 bonus
